# Redistributable family fixtures

These `.rfa` files are MIT-licensed samples from public GitHub repositories (not the
Autodesk `rac_basic_sample_family` corpus). Each binary has a sibling
`<name>.license.json` with source URL, SPDX license, SHA256, and size.

| Fixture | Source | License | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `empty.rfa` | `DynamoDS/RevitTestFramework` | MIT | Minimal family file |

Project-shaped synthetic CFB test fixtures live under `corpus/tier1/`.
